mapper.select: SELECT notice_id AS "noticeId" /* 공지사항 ID */ , title AS "title" /* 공지사항 제목 */ , content AS "content" /* 공지사항 내용 */ , view_count AS "viewCount" /* 조회수 */ , use_yn AS "useYn" /* 사용 여부 */ , created_at AS "createdAt" /* 등록 일시 */ , updated_at AS "updatedAt" /* 수정 일시 */ FROM notice WHERE use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY notice_id DESC

SELECT notice_id AS "noticeId" /* 공지사항 ID */ , title AS "title" /* 공지사항 제목 */ , content AS "content" /* 공지사항 내용 */ , view_count AS "viewCount" /* 조회수 */ , use_yn AS "useYn" /* 사용 여부 */ , created_at AS "createdAt" /* 등록 일시 */ , updated_at AS "updatedAt" /* 수정 일시 */ FROM notice WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE notice SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} AND use_yn = 'Y'
